run_mdqn_atari: run Munchausen-DQN on an Atari environment like Pong with configurable steps and seed
build_experiment_config_mdqn: build an MDQN experiment config with DQNConfig, MunchausenQLearning loss, and DQNBuilder
run_distributed_mdqn: run the MDQN experiment distributed across 128 actors or locally with 4 actors
run_single_threaded_mdqn: run the MDQN experiment single-threaded by passing the run_distributed flag as False
configure_dqn_agent: configure a DQN agent with learning rate, replay size, epsilon, and target update period
